name: Mannheim

sourceReview.localCustodian: Stadt Mannheim, Fachbereich Geoinformation und Stadtplanung
sourceReview.localRegistryEvidence: Official Mannheim Geobasisdaten and Geoportal pages identify the Liegenschaftskataster/ALKIS and the municipal Flurstücke layer; the current viewer configuration names alkis_flurstuecke and uses the municipal mapserver.
sourceReview.generalAgencyDistinction: The Mannheim pages are local custodian evidence. General German/Baden-Württemberg cadastral references were not treated as a local parcel endpoint unless directly tied to the Mannheim viewer.

discovery.outcome: Both searches found first-party Mannheim pages and the public Geoportal; the native-language search additionally surfaced the official OGC services page and viewer’s Flurstücksuche.

requestOutcomes.outcome: PNG returned for alkis_flurstuecke; visualization only, no vector ID/geometry retained.

scopeLimits: The map image proves a reachable municipal parcel visualization, not an admitted parcel adapter.
A zero exact-point query result is not evidence of citywide absence.
No citywide completeness, licensing terms, or stable native vector identity was proven.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
nativeFieldMapping: No returned vector feature, so no native field names or composite identity were retained; internal synthetic IDs were not used.
uncertainty: The public service may support an application-specific query path or only map rendering for anonymous users. Further qualification must follow the viewer’s own request flow and remain bounded.
